title: DOB structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of Date-of-Birth candidates paired with label prefix and calendar-validity verdicts. Mirrors Swift ``detectDOBs`` (label prefix + M/D range) plus ``DOBDetector.isStructurallyValid`` (per-month day cap + Gregorian leap-year rule).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one DOB candidate with its expected calendar-validity verdict.

text.description: Full candidate string with label prefix (e.g. ``DOB: 3/15/1985``).

date_part.description: The date-only portion after the label prefix is stripped.

valid.description: Whether the date is a real Gregorian calendar date.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this date, or null if valid.
